description: This file defines a configuration class for Milvus Vector Store integration, including methods to validate environment variables, construct API URLs, transform search requests and responses, and manage other vector store operations specific to Milvus, utilizing the Azure AI Search API and embedding models from litellm.

classes.name: MilvusVectorStoreConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Milvus Vector Store operations, including validation, URL construction, request and response transformations, and environment setup.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] )
methods.description: Validates and updates the request headers with the Milvus API key.

methods.name: BaseVectorStoreAuthCredentials get_auth_credentials( self, litellm_params: dict )
methods.description: Retrieves authentication credentials for Milvus based on provided parameters.

methods.name: VectorStoreIndexEndpoints get_vector_store_endpoints_by_type(self)
methods.description: Returns the API endpoints used for reading and writing in the vector store.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, drop_params: bool )
methods.description: Maps parameters to optional Milvus parameters; adds relevant params to optional params dictionary.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Milvus API base URL, fetching from environment if not provided.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict[str,Any]] transform_search_vector_store_request( self, vector_store_id: str, query: Union[str, List[str]], vector_store_search_optional_params: VectorStoreSearchOptionalRequestParams, api_base: str, litellm_logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms a search request into the format expected by Milvus/Azure API, including embedding generation.

methods.name: VectorStoreSearchResponse transform_search_vector_store_response( self, response: httpx.Response, litellm_logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj )
methods.description: Transforms the API response into a standard vector store search response object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_create_vector_store_request( self, vector_store_create_optional_params: VectorStoreCreateOptionalRequestParams, api_base: str, )
methods.description: Placeholder for request transformation when creating a vector store (not implemented).

methods.name: VectorStoreCreateResponse transform_create_vector_store_response( self, response: httpx.Response )
methods.description: Placeholder for response transformation when creating a vector store (not implemented).
